comments.body:
This also appears to have traces of `NameError` in `psu_base.py` that are now fixed by https://github.com/Azure/sonic-platform-common/pull/143
The latest image should not report below errors that are logged in this issue:
```
Nov 19 15:51:16.425670 str2-7050cx3-acs-06 INFO pmon#supervisord: xcvrd File "/usr/local/lib/python2.7/dist-packages/sonic_platform_base/psu_base.py", line 30, in PsuBase

Nov 19 15:51:16.425882 str2-7050cx3-acs-06 INFO pmon#supervisord: xcvrd NameError: name 'STATUS_LED_COLOR_OFF' is not defined
```
